findings.title: Missing: Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.description: Restricts external resource loading and provides robust defense against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
findings.remediation: Configure CSP header: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'

findings.title: Missing: Clickjacking Defense (X-Frame-Options)
findings.description: Prevents unauthorized framing of the web application inside hostile iframes.
findings.remediation: Add header: X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN

findings.title: Missing: MIME Sniffing Protection (X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.description: Prevents web browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared content-type.

findings.title: Missing: Referrer Policy
findings.description: Protects private internal URL parameters from leaking to external referrers.

findings.title: Missing: Browser Feature Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Controls browser access to sensitive device APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation).
findings.remediation: Add header: Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()
